Commentary.Commentary: Jadeja and Pandya were the pick of the bowlers for India on a pitch that looked a touch two-paced. There was some movement with the new ball and also later on in the innings with the odd ball gripping as well. It was still a good batting pitch to bat on and the England batsmen reveled on it. The target is definitely challenging but India will be confident after their win in Pune. Join us in a while for the chase.

A good performance from England after being put into bat. England's top four all got starts with Roy and Bairstow getting fifties but once again no England player managed to make a really big knock. There was a lull towards the back end but Stokes produced a cracking fifty and was supported by a fine cameo from Woakes as England surged past the 320-run mark.

OUT! Wicket to end proceedings! Full toss outside off, Plunkett steps out and mistimes the lofted stroke towards long off. They go for the second but Pandey's throw from the deep is quite good. Dhoni whips off the bails in a flash and it's referred upstairs. Replays confirms that Plunkett is well short. ENGLAND FINISH ON 321/8.
The umpire has referred it upstairs!
Very full and outside off, squeezed through point for a single.
LIAM PLUNKETT walks in next!

OUT! CONFUSION AND GONE! Slower ball down the leg side, Woakes misses the flick and it is a wide. Stokes wants a single but his partner is too late to react. Woakes sacrifices his wicket eventually as he is way short at the bowler's end. Dhoni casually throws it to Kumar who whips off the bails perfectly. Very handy knock from Woakes nevertheless.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is a gem of a cameo from Woakes! Fuller ball on leg stump, he backs away a lot and pumps it inside out towards the deep cover fence for a boundary. Beautiful stroke.
Very full and outside off, Stokes propels it through the covers for a single. He slipped a bit after completing the run and so doesn't take the second run.
Fuller outside off, bunted towards cover for a single.
Full toss and very wide outside off, would have been a wide but Stokes reaches it. Carves it off the outer half towards deep backward point for a single.
Very full outside off,  Woakes looks to glide it down to third man but is beaten.
A good yorker outside off, Woakes fails to dig it out.
Fuller on middle, Woakes makes room and swings it down towards wide long on where Kohli makes a fine stop. Keeps the batsmen down to two.

FOUR! And again! Full toss and Woakes backs away to slap it through point as the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary. Bumrah is losing the plot at the moment and leaking runs. Kohli won't be amused at all.
FOUR! Clubbed! Much needed flourish into the innings. Fuller outside off, Woakes makes room and drills it between extra cover and mid off to find the fence. Powerful stroke.
50-run partnership is up between Woakes and Stokes! Also, this brings up 300 for England!
SIX! STREAKY RUNS! Shortish on middle and leg, Woakes swivels for the pull but gets a top edge on it. Small area of the ground and it clears fine leg comfortably for a biggie. 300 up for England.
Another full ball on the stumps, Stokes makes room and clubs it towards wide long on where it is well stopped. Another brace.
Fuller on middle and leg, dug out past mid-wicket for a brace.
8th ODI fifty for Stokes.
FOUR! Bad ball and Stokes pounces on it. Full toss and gives him the chance to free his arms. Hacks it through backward point for a boundary. This has been a blistering knock from the all-rounder.
Fullish outside off, Woakes digs it past point for a run.
Very full and on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish on off, makes room and gets a top edge on the pull straight down the ground. Kohli from long on covers a lot of ground to his left to keep the batsmen down to just a single.
Shortish outside off, Stokes backs away to play the upper cut but misses.
Full toss around off, Stokes steps out and heaves it away towards wide long on. Jadeja runs across to his right to make a good stop. A brace taken.
Almost a yorker on off, Woakes backs away and digs it to point for a single.
Low full toss outside off, squeezed towards deep backward point for a brace. Jadeja fumbles a bit and that allowed the second run with ease.
Shortish outside off, Woakes makes room to slash it away but gets a thick edge. Goes fine towards third man where Kumar makes a good stop. Brace taken.
Dug in short outside off, Woakes makes room to play a flat batted stroke but misses.
Fuller on the stumps, Stokes slams it towards wide long on for another brace.
Fuller on the pads, Stokes shovels it through mid-wicket for a brace.

NOT OUT! Speared wide outside off, Stokes makes room to dig it out as the ball goes towards Dhoni. Stifled appeal for a catch and the umpires want to refer it upstairs. Soft signal is not out. Replays confirm that there was a bottom edge but it fell short of Dhoni. So, the on-field call stays.
They are going upstairs to see if it is a catch or a bump ball. Soft signal is NOT OUT.

FOUR! SMASHED! Tries the yorker again but Stokes steps out to convert it into a low full toss. Slams it straight down the ground to the long on fence for a boundary. There was a fielder there but he could hardly budge.
Yorker outside off, Stokes fails to dig it out on the charge.
SIX! WHAT A STRIKE! Slower ball wider outside off, Stokes steps out to that one and muscles the flat batted stroke over long on for a massive score. Lovely start to the over for England.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR is back.
Back of a length outside off, Woakes tries to drive on the up but misses.
Full and outside off, leans across and pushes it through mid on for a single.
Deep square leg moves to fine leg.

FOUR! Finds the fence! Shortish on middle and leg, Stokes swivels to pull but gets a fair bit of glove on it. Gets it well past the keeper to the fine leg fence. India need to be careful here not to overdo the short ball ploy.
Shortish down the leg side, that shall be a wide.
Good length on middle and leg, worked through square leg for a brace.
Shortish outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Dug in short on middle and leg, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, gets back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length outside off, late cuts it down to third man where Ashwin makes a good stop to keep the batsmen to a single.
Length ball angled in around off, pushed it back to the bowler.
FOUR! FINE SHOT! Dug in short on middle, Woakes swivels and controls the pull really well through backward square leg. Middled it really well and the ball raced away to the ropes.
Length ball outside off, stays back and slams it to extra cover. Jadhav fumbles a bit and the batsmen take a single.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot well.
CHRIS WOAKES is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! The short ball does Ali again. Banged in midway down the track and it's well-directed. Ali goes for the pull and gets a top edge that flies high to backward point where Jadeja settles under the chance with ease. The England innings is losing steam in the death overs.
Shortish around off, pulled hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length around off, chopped to the off side for a quick single.

Four leg byes! Bonus runs! Shortish around off, Ali goes for the pull and the ball flies over the keeper to the fence for a boundary. Leg bye signaled strangely as it clearly came off the top edge. No batsman will like it if runs are not given even if it is a top edge.
Shortish around off, Stokes mistimes the pull towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length angled in around off, gets back to fend but gets a leading edge to point. One bounce to the off side.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back on.
Length ball angled in closer to off, blocked well from the crease.
Back of a length around off, punched off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Almost another! Dug in short on leg stump, Ali takes his eyes off while trying the pull. Gets a top edge that goes down  to fine leg. One bounce and they take a single.
MOEEN ALI walks in to bat.

OUT! PANDYA STRIKES! He is showing this knack of breaking partnerships and it's certainly valuable in shorter formats. Length ball and wider outside off, Bairstow makes room and slices it towards backward point where Jadeja takes a fine diving catch. Yet another England batsman wasting a start and failing to bat deep. These are vital strikes for India.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and punches it to mid off. Single taken.
Shortish on off, Bairstow mistimes the pull past mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy on a length outside off, crunched off the back foot but straight to extra cover.
Floated on the pads, gets across and clips it to the leg side for a single.
Flighted outside off, drilled through the covers for a single.
Floated outside off, punched off the back foot to deep backward point for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, goes across and flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! LAUNCHED! Top shot from Stokes. Flighted ball around off, he just charges down the track and lofts it straight down the ground. Hits it very straight and so gets it well past the long on fielder for a flat maximum.
Power Play 3 has been signaled. Five fielders can now be allowed outside the ring.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket with soft hands for a single. Another tight over from Pandya! Just 5 from it!
A touch fuller, tapped on the up to Rahul at extra cover.
Almost drags it on! Length delivery, angling away, Ben looks to guide it but gets a bottom edge. The ball lands just outside off and goes behind to Dhoni.
FOUR! Through the gap! Back of a length delivery, angling away, chopped through cover-point for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.
Beaten! On a length outside off, BS looks to play it with the angle but the ball straightens and goes past the outside edge.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Spinning into the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Jonny gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it on the bounce.
3rd ODI fifty for Bairstow.
FOUR! On middle and off, JB reverse sweeps it past short third man for a boundary. Gets to his half century!
Stokes gets to the pitch of the ball, eases it to long off for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven to long on for a single.
BEN STOKES walks out to bat.

OUT! Pandya has his man! Full outside off, Buttler drives it uppishly straight to Rahul at short extra cover, who takes it safely. Another failure for Buttler! Pandya gets his rewards for bowling a superb tight spell!
Length delivery outside off, cut to point. Jadeja leaps to his left and makes a great stop. He then instantly has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single is completed!
Short deliver outside off, pulled to mid on.

NOT OUT! Decision overturned! Length delivery, angling in, Bairstow is cut into halves and the ball zips through. There's a sound as the ball goes past him. The Indians appeal and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Bairstow after a chat with Buttler takes the review. The Snicko shows that there wasn't bat involved and the sound was of the ball brushing the shirt. Good delivery nonetheless!
Jonny Bairstow has been adjudged caught behind, he takes the review!
Length outside off, Buttler edges it into the ground. Kohli at first slip leaps to his right and half stops the ball. A single taken!
Peach of a delivery! Length delivery outside off, Jos looks to defend it with the angle but gets beaten as the ball seams away after pitching.
LBW appeal turned down! Tossed up outside off, Bairstow gets down on one knee and looks to sweep it but misses and is rapped up on the pads. Appeal for it is turned down. Impact outside off maybe!
Spinning in, Bairstow plays it with the turn to short mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery outside off, tapped through covers for a single.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Swept away! Fuller on the pads, Jonny kneels down and sweeps it through fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, whipped over mid-wicket. Catch it is the call but the ball lands just short of deep mid-wicket fielder. A single taken!
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN is back on!
Full outside off, steered to Yuvi at point.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot to covers for a single.
Banged in short again, Buttler takes eyes of his ball and pays the price as it whizzes past his helmet.
On the shorter side of the length, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Banged in short, Buttler looks to pull it but misses. Good delivery!
Outside off, zips through after pitching, Jonny looks to block it, but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Sliding in, punched off the back foot through covers. Pandya with a superb diving effort keeps it down to one.
FOUR! Edgy boundary! Tossed up outside off, Buttler looks to drive it but gets it off the outside edge. Past Kohli at first slip, also beats Bumrah at short third man to reach the fence.
Full outside off, spinning away, pushed through covers for a single.
Slightly slower through the air, Bairstow looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball spins away, catches the outside edge and flies past Dhoni. The ball goes to short third man. No run taken!
Outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
RAVINDRA JADEJA is back for his last over!
Back of a length delivery outside off, JB looks to play it on the back foot but gets it off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
On a length outside off, Buttler walks across and looks to cut it but misses.
JOS BUTTLER is the new man in.
Drinks taken with that wicket!

OUT! That's disappointing from the English skipper! Length delivery on the pads, Morgan looks to flick it on its way but fails to keep it down on the ground. It goes straight to Bumrah at short fine leg. He doesn't even have to move an inch and grabs it cleanly. Three dot balls built the pressure on the skipper. Pandya gets his first of the match!
Length delivery outside off, chopped to backward point.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Back of a length delivery, defended straight back.
WIDE! Down the leg side, EM looks to tuck it but misses.
HARDIK PANDYA is brought back on!
BEATEN! Quicker one outside off, Jonny looks to guide it but misses as he is beaten by pace.
Slides it in, punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Fires it in, Bairstow defends it off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Carrom ball, spinning in, turned with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Short and sliding down leg, Morgan stays back, clears his front leg and jabs it over mid-wicket for a biggie! What a confident shot! England on the march!
Drags his length a touch short, JB camps back and punches it through mid-wicket for a single.

On the pads, clipped to short mid-wicket. Kohli there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Jadhav does a great job backing up as he prevents overthrow runs. Good over for England, 13 runs off it!
SIX! Morgan takes Jadeja downtown! Tossed up outside off, lofted over the bowler's head for a maximum.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Darted in on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! Gets to the pitch of the ball, lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
On the pads, tickled round the corner to short fine leg for a single.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
FOUR! Low full toss, angling in, Morgan uses his feet and drives it past Ashwin. There's no long on for and the ball races to the fence.
On the pads, turned through behind square on the leg side for a single.
On middle, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Skids it in from middle and off, worked to square leg.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN is back on!
Flatter on middle and leg, strikes Bairstow on the thigh pad.
Fuller outside off, smeared square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Floated on a length outside off, steered towards point for a single.
Fuller on the pads, worked on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, bunted down to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Morgan uses his feet and defends well.
Length ball outside off, steps out and blocks it to cover for a quick single.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards point.

SIX! CLOBBERED! Makes the Free Hit count. High full toss and almost a no ball again as Morgan responds with a mighty pull over deep backward square leg for a mammoth biggie. This is turning out to be a very eventful over.
Free Hit coming up!

FORTUNE FOR BAIRSTOW! Shortish outside off, Bairstow goes for the upper cut but doesn't get the distance on the shot. Finds Ashwin at third man to perfection. They go upstairs to check for the no ball and Bumrah has overstepped clearly. Reprieve for Bairstow. Bumrah only has himself to blame.
They are checking for the no ball. Bairstow has been caught at third man.
Back of a length on leg stump, misses the flick and the ball rolls off the thigh pad on the leg side. They take a leg bye.

NOT OUT! The sound was of the ball hitting both pads. Back of a length angling away from Morgan. It straightens after pitching as the ball sneaks through off the pads to Dhoni. Big appeal for a catch as the Indians feel there was an inside edge. Kohli opts for the review although Dhoni isn't that confident. Nothing on the Ultra Edge and the on-field call stays.
India have reviewed for a catch against Morgan. It came off the thigh pad but was there any inside edge? There was a sound. Kohli is very confident.
Bumper around off, Morgan swivels to pull but misses.

FOUR! NICE SHOT! Full and outside off, Bairstow reaches out and drives it sweetly square of the wicket. Made terrific connection as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. He is looking in good touch.
Fuller on middle, bunted towards long on for a single.
Loopy on off, Bairstow shapes up for the slog sweep but gets it off the inside half towards deep fine leg where Rahane covers good ground to keep the batsmen to just a single.
Flatter outside off, Bairstow steps out and blocks well.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards mid off.
On a length around off, punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Lovely bowling! Another very full ball angled into the stumps, Bairstow just about digs it out with a soft leading edge to point.
Very full and outside off, swinging away as Bairstow is beaten on the push.
Back of a length outside off, Morgan stays back and cuts it towards square third man for a single.
Spears it well down the leg side, Morgan misses the flick.

FOUR! MORGAN GETS LUCKY! He was giving the charge and Bumrah responded with a slower ball on middle. Eoin goes through with the heave and gets a thick inside that just goes past leg stump. Dhoni dives to his right but the ball sneaks through him to the fence.
Shortish outside off, steers down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Bairstow gets a bottom edge on the cut towards first slip.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back.
Loopy closer to off, blocked well from the crease.
Morgan premediates the paddle scoop and lobs it high just over the vacant short fine leg region as it trickles to the deep for a brace.
Floated around off, Morgan gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Loopy outside off, leans into it and blocks well.
Fuller outside off, jammed towards cover for a single.
SIX! SMASHED! Bairstow decides to take on Jadeja. This was generously tossed up outside off, Bairstow steps out to that one and lofts it cleanly down the ground over long off for a maximum.
On a length around off, stays back and pushes it towards point for a single.
Flighted around off, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around off, JB steps out and gets across to work it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted outside off, Bairstow gets forward and pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Floated on middle, Bairstow gets across and nails the sweep through square leg. He plays this shot really well and that rocketed to the ropes.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and drills it down to long on for a single.
Extra bounce! Looped on from outside off, Bairstow gets forward to block but the ball sprins up off the deck to hit him on the glove.
Drifting in from around off, lunges forward and pats it towards cover.
Fired in fuller outside off, squeezed out towards mid off.
Floated on middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, Morgan is pinged on the pads as he fails to get bat on ball.
Flatter outside off, goes back and cuts it towards short third man.
Drifting in from outside off, sits back and punches it to deep extra cover for a couple.
Flatter outside off, gets back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Floated around off, Morgan misses the reverse sweep and there is an appeal for lbw that dies instantly. Replays confirm why as there was glove involved.
Fuller on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and blocks well.
Floated outside off, Bairstow goes back to cut but misses. A bit of extra bounce there.

Huge appeal! Drifting in from outside off, Morgan looks to push at it as the ball whizzes through to Dhoni. Huge appeal for a catch but turned down. Kohli is very excited and thinks of the review but the former captain's body language suggests otherwise and the optimism dies out.
Floated outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks well.
Floated outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
On a length outside off, whipped off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Bairstow drilled down the ground to long off for a single.
Floated on off, pushed off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Floated on middle, Bairstow works it down to long on for a single.
Nicely tossed up around off, Morgan pushes it down to long on for a single.
Drifting in from middle, comes in with the angle to rap Morgan on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks.
Flatter around off, premeditated sweep from Bairstow but he is struck on the pads. Loud lbw appeal, impact was outside the line. A leg bye taken.
Flighted on a length outside off, blocked firmly off the back foot to the off side.
Flighted outside off, reaches out to block but gets it off the outer half of the blade.
Loopy around off, defends it well off the inside half to the leg side.
EOIN MORGAN is the new man in.

OUT! 3 ON 3 FOR JADEJA! Number of times that he has got Roy this series. Almost a replica of the dismissal in the previous ODI this. Flatter on middle, no room or length for the cut but Roy tries to create some by backing away. He misses and trust Jadeja to be accurate with his line as the ball crashes into the sticks. Once again Roy fails to kick on after getting a start.
Floated outside off, stays back and jams it to the leg side.
Floated on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy on leg stump, gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Floated on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! EDGED BUT NO SLIP! Ashwin is disappointed but he has his captain to blame here. His very first over and there isn't a slip in place. Coming to the ball, it was drifting in from outside off, skids on after pitching as Roy goes for a big drive. Gets the thick edge that goes well past Dhoni to the third man fence.
Fired in on middle and leg, Bairstow gets back and works it past short fine leg for a single.
Flatter on leg stump, Roy gets back and glances it to short fine leg where Yuvraj misjudges the bounce to let it through. Single taken.
On a length outside off, crunched off the back foot but straight to extra cover.
Starts with a dart down the leg side, wide called.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes on to bowl.
Flighted on leg stump, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, bunted down to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven down to long on for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a single.
JONNY BAIRSTOW is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Jadeja breaks the partnership. Billings would be disappointed with himself. Tried the reverse sweep to a loopy ball well outside off and got it off the toe end. Lobs it high to backward point where Bumrah takes a good catch with a timely leap. The partnership has been broken but this is a fine platform for England. It's also 150th wicket in the ODIs for Jadeja!
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot to long off for a single.
Drinks break.....
Flatter outside off, Billings goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge on to the pitch as Dhoni stops it.
Floated outside off, steps out to that one and taps it back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, gets back and punches it to long on for a single.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Half-tracker outside off, Roy sits back and cuts it away through backward point. Made terrific contact and the ball speeds away to the fence for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Billings gets back and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Floated outside off, steps out and pats it back to Yuvraj who does well to stop it.
Fuller outside off, worked behind square leg for a single.
Drifting in on middle, whipped away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
8th ODI fifty for Roy.

SIX! Tonked! Floated on middle and leg, Roy charges down the track and lofts it cleanly over long on for a mammoth biggie. Jadeja was his nemesis in the last two games and the opener decides to put him under pressure. Roy continues his great form in the series.
Flighted outside off, drills it down to long off for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, whipped through mid-wicket for a brace. Good stop near the fence.
RAVINDRA JADEJA comes on to bowl.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut over covers for a single.

Leg bye! LBW appeal turned down! Full outside off, Sam kneels down and looks to sweep but misses and is rapped up on the pads. The ball deflects on the leg side and the batsmen run through for a leg bye. Kohli asks Dhoni whether or not to opt for the review and Dhoni says no.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Swept away! Sliding into the pads, Billings sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Billings gets down the track but plays down the wrong line and gets hit on the pads.
Outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
Leg bye! Length delivery outside, Roy shuffles and looks to work it on the leg side but misses and is rapped up on the thigh pad.
WIDE! Angling down leg, JR leaves it. A wide is signalled!
Great piece of timing! Back of a length outside off, punched through backward point. Kumar cuts it out in the deep but still Roy completes his brace.
FOUR! Almost drags it on! On a length outside off, angling in, Roy looks to play it across the line but gets lucky. As the inside edge goes past the off stump and for a boundary through fine leg.
Bye! Bouncer, angling in, Sam looks to hooks it but misses. Dhoni behind the stumps jumps to his left but fails to grab it cleanly. The batsmen run through for a bye., One for the over is signalled!
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Roy drags it through widish mid on. Pandya from mid on cuts it out with a dive and keeps it down to one.
Short outside off, Billings goes back cuts it through covers for a single.
Flatter one, sliding in, Sam looks to work it on the leg side but gets it back to the bowler.
Flatter around off, Billings dances down and turns it to backward square leg. Billings wants a single but is sent back by Roy. Dhoni looks to parry it onto the stumps but misses.
On the shorter side again, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Sliding into Billings, he goes back and plays it through mid-wicket for a single.
In the air...but in the gap! Not a good start from Yuvi, lands it short outside off, Roy cuts it uppishly through point for a single. Missed out on that half-tracker!
YUVRAJ SINGH has been brought on!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Roy shuffles a touch and drags it through widish mid on for a single.
Very full on the boots, clipped through mid-wicket. There's protection in the deep and only a single taken.
Fullish outside off, Sam prods forward in defence.
Length delivery outside off, angling in, straightens a touch. Roy looks to play it across the line and gets square up. The leading edge takes the ball towards third man for a single.
Angling in, Roy covers his stumps and punches it on the up to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, gently pushed off the back foot to cover-point for a single.
FOUR! On the shorter side again, Roy pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good shot that!
Back of a length delivery outside off, gently tapped off the back foot in the point region for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Nothing quite like a straight drive! Full outside off, Billings drives it off the inner half of his bat. Gets it past Pandya and to the long off fence.
On the hips, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off, Roy bends his knees to cut it but the ball keeps low and goes past the bottom edge.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle. Hardik Pandya is back on with change of ends!
Beauty to end the over! Pitched outside off, SB looks to drive it but misses again!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, Billings walks across and plays it to mid-wicket.
What a comeback! On a length and angling in, nips back in, Billings is beaten completely. The ball goes through the gap between his bat and the body.
FOUR! Full outside off, this time Billings connects his drive and it races to the cover fence like a tracer bullet.
Banged in short, angling in, Billings looks to hook it but misses. Good delivery! Bumrah has a glee on his face after that!
Full and angling in, clipped through mid-wicket. Yuvui in the deep cuts it out and keeps it down to a brace.
FOUR! Runs after 11 dot balls! On a length and outside off, Roy chooses the aerial route. Goes over cover-point and gets a boundary.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut to backward point again.
Wide outside off, tapped to backward point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut into the ground to backward point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, Billing looks to connect his drive but is beaten again! Maiden to start off from Bumrah!
Back of a length delivery outside off, chopped to backward point.
Edged but fell short! Slightly fuller outside off, Billing looks to drive, nicks one this time but the ball lands short of the second slip fielder.
Beaten for the third time in a row! On a length around off, Billings looks to defend it with a straight bat but plays down the wrong line and the ball flies past the outside edge once again.
Back of a length delivery, SB tries to cut but misses again!
Beaten, who else? Billings is having a nightmare out in the middle! Length delivery, angling in, straightens a touch, Billings looks to defend it but is beaten again!
JASPRIT BUMRAH is the first change!
On a length and outside off, Roy looks to run it down but gets a bottom edge into the ground and towards the keeper.
Educated edge! Length delivery outside off, edged through to third man for a single.
Outside off, Billings walks ahead and blocks it on the off side.
Again Sam is beaten! Full and outside off, this one moves away, Billing is beaten in his drive!
Risky leave! Pitched outside off, Billings thinks it as another outswinger and leaves it but the ball nips in massively and goes just past the off stump.
Outside off, Billings looks to cut it late but the ball keeps a touch low and goes from under his bat.
FOUR! Driven! Full outside off, driven sweetly through mid off. Rahane is slightly wider and the ball races to the fence. Boundary to end the over!
Full and wide outside off, Roy looks to play it by walking ahead a touch but is beaten as the ball swings away.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Hardik Pandya pulls out of his run up. Might have overrun slightly!
On a length and angling in, tucked through square leg for a single.
Billings is beaten for the umpteenth time! Outside off, Billings looks to defend it off the front foot but plays down the wrong line. The ball whizzes past the outside edge again!
Length delivery outside off, Billings opts to not have a go at it.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off. Another good over for England, 8 runs off it!
Length delivery, angling in, Roy gets across and defends it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Full and angling in, Roy flicks it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket. Ashwin from mid on chases it but fails to prevent the ball from reaching the fence. Another boundary!
Fullish around off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Cut over! Back of a length delivery outside off, width on offer. Roy makes full use of it and slashes it over backward point for a boundary.
Great delivery! Length delivery just outside off, Roy looked to play it on the up but the extra bounce with a hint of away movement beats Roy in his shot.

FOUR! More runs! Third boundary of the over and the England innings has taken off after the lull in the first two overs. Too straight from Pandya and he pays the price. Billings whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
BEATEN! Billings almost fell to the trap. Pandya persists with the fuller ball and this time Billings is lucky not to get an edge as he misses the expansive drive. The ball shaped away late.
FOUR! SHOT! Billings is finally off the mark and in some style. Fuller ball outside off, Billings essays a lovely cover drive. Timed it sweetly and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Good length on the pads, gets across and clips it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Fullish delivery, angling in, Roy flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He is very strong off his pads!
Back of a length delivery, moving away, Roy shoulders his arms to let that through.
Back of a length delivery, cut straight to Yuvraj at backward point.
Brings it in this time, SB defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Bhuvneshwar likes to mix it up!
Outside off, shaping away, left alone.
BEATEN AGAIN! Fullish outside off, moves away, Billings looks to drive it on the up but is beaten by the away movement of the ball.
On a length outside off, cut past backward point for a single.

FOUR! Fuller length delivery, angling in, Roy shuffles way across and clips it off his pads through mid-wicket for a boundary. First one of the match! Still, it's a risky shot as if he misses, he will be caught dead plumb before wicket.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. MAIDEN OVER!
On a length outside off, Billings steps down and shoulders his arms.
Good delivery! Pitches it a touch outside off, Billings looks to drive it but the ball moves away and beats the outside edge of his bat.
Another leave to the outside off delivery.
This time a touch closer but it's still outside off. Sam leaves it as the ball moves away after pitching.
Full and wide outside off, Billings doesn't flirt with it.
HARDIK PANDYA to bowl from the other end with the other new ball!
BEATEN! Peach of a delivery! On a length outside off and angling in, Roy looks to defend it with the angle but the ball straightens a touch and whistles past the outside edge!
Full around off, Roy defends it off the front foot to widish mid off.
WIDE! Wide outside off, Roy looks to slash it but checks his shot at the last moment as it's too wide. The umpire signals it as a wide. First runs on board!
Extra bounce! Back of a length delivery, rises a touch extra, Roy looks to poke at it but gets beaten by the extra bounce on offer. Good start by Bhuvneshwar!
Bhuvi makes this nip back in from a length outside off, Roy defends it solidly with a straight bat.
Full and wide outside off, Roy with another leave.
Good delivery to start off. Pitched outside off, moves away after pitching, Roy makes a watchful leave.
The national anthems have been done and dusted. The English openers, JASON ROY and SAM BILLINGS have now walked in the middle. BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR to start the proceedings with the ball. Let's play...

EOIN MORGAN is surprised at the grass on the pitch but feels that it is a good pitch. Accepts that their bowlers haven't quite been up to scratch and hopes that they can improve. Feels that England haven't played the perfect game yet and expects his team to put in a collective performance today. Reveals two changes with Hales ruled out of the tour and Root missing this game, both to injuries. SAM BILLINGS and JONNY BAIRSTOW come in.

VIRAT KOHLI says that India will bowl. Feels that it is a good pitch and doesn't opine that it will change much as the game progresses. Stresses on the importance of maintaining the winning habit. Hopes that his side can be ruthless and finish the series on a high. Says that there has been dew albeit not so much but still states that it could be a factor. Reveals the one change - Shikhar Dhawan makes way for AJINKYA RAHANE.
Time for the toss. Kohli flips the coin in the air, heads is the call from Morgan and it's a tail. INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BOWL.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar says the surface has slight sprinkling of grass which will help the bowlers, especially under the lights. Adds that it is a good batting surface nevertheless and opines that dew could be a factor later on.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the final ODI of the series. It's been a run feast so far and today doesn't appear to be any different. There hasn't been much to choose between the two sides, just that India have just dealt with the pressure moments better. Kohli will want his side to affect a whitewash in his first ODI series as permanent captain. England will need to improve drastically in their bowling department to avoid embarrassment. The toss and other updates are coming up shortly.
